name: Canvas MCP Sync
description: Sends read-only snapshots of your Canvas courses to your own Canvas MCP Portal while you are signed in to Canvas.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
